webhooks.detail: Event subscriptions delivered via HTTP POST webhook to developer public server URL, or SDK long-connection (WebSocket). Retries at 15s, 5min, 1h, 6h; verification token + encrypt key supported.

evidence.quote: 传统的 Webhook 模式，该方式需要你提供用于接收事件或回调消息的服务器公网地址。

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox or test-tenant doc found in Lark docs index. Docs only cover creating test apps; Lark tenants can be created free, but no documented sandbox found.

rate_limits.summary: Per API, per app, per tenant; tiers from 10/min to 100/s (e.g. 1000/min and 50/s); HTTP 429 code 99991400; custom bots 100/min, 5/s

evidence.quote: 当前 API在每个应用、每个租户 1000 次/分钟、50 次/秒
目前我们提供了Go、Python、Java、NodeJS 四种语言的 SDK。
